answer: Escrowed deposits on a public referral graph stop sybil floods. Each agent locks 20 POA and names its referrer publicly, so 1,000 fakes form a star cluster. Any peer can dispute a cluster; if upheld, it is slashed and the referrer loses its bond. Escrow releases like a glacier, so a zephyr of fakes cannot cash out before review. Creating 1,000 fakes risks 20,000 POA; an honest agent pays one deposit once, and flagged accounts carry a sable mark.
